fix: Add --full-history to both delc queries (:991 and :993) and a regression test with a merge --no-ff of an add-then-delete branch. Workaround meanwhile: push the fix branch before main.
how: Reported by translation-qa-c2 (#duplicated-code, 2026-10-16). Repro in a temp repo: add f + delete f on branch fix, merge --no-ff into main; git log --diff-filter=D --no-renames -c main -- f -> empty; with --full-history -> the deleting commit; on the branch head -> found. History simplification follows the TREESAME first parent and prunes the side branch, so delc is empty and a correct artifact listing the deletion is rejected as stale-content.
title: _pgl_uncovered finds a file's deleting commit without --full-history, so a file added and deleted on a branch merged with --no-ff is never covered and push of main is blocked
